 >_ sshTermy                                                                                             ● AI
 ▤ Command sets · what sshTermy types, reads and tells the AI for each vendor

 Own sets live in ~/.config/sshtermy/befehlssaetze.
 They can only add to built-in danger rules, only type read commands and only detect a device when no built-
in set matches.
